caption:
i really thought everyone my age was ahead of me.

turns out the feed is built from exceptions.

how old are you, and what are you building? 👇

slides.query: average age of a successful startup founder
slides.result: A study of 2.7 million US founders found the average age of the most successful high-growth founders was **45 years old.**
slides.source: Azoulay, Jones, Kim & Miranda, AER: Insights (2020)

slides.query: how old was colonel sanders when he started kfc
slides.result: Harland Sanders started franchising Kentucky Fried Chicken in 1952, at **62 years old.**
